dedupe_keys.name: referentiel routier points de repere pr des routes departementales de haute vienne

description: Référentiel routier - Points de repère (PR) des routes départementales de Haute-Vienne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Haute-Vienne. Ce jeu de données précise les points de repère (ou bornage) du réseau routier départementale de la Haute-Vienne. \ Ce référentiel permet de connaître et d'identifier le réseau routier départemental. C'est le support qui permet de réaliser des représentations cartographiques des données routières localisées en Route + PR + abscisse. Coverage: Département de la Haute-Vienne. The publisher named on the listing is Département de la Haute-Vienne. Its keywords include referentiel-routier, referentiel, routes, bornage, haute-vienne, point-de-repere. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
